calibration_sources: FlashAttention-2/3 flash_attn_varlen_func (1D Unpadded cu_seqlens Block-Diagonal Masking)
LinkedIn Liger-Kernel FusedLinearCrossEntropy (Chunked In-Place Logit Gradient Without Materializing [B*S, V])
Kalajdzievski et al. rsLoRA (Rank-Stabilized Scaling alpha/sqrt(r)) & DoRA Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation

workload_baseline.dataset: 500,000 SFT samples (mean length 1,850 tokens, long-tail up to 16,384 tokens)

tiers.name: Tier 1: Naive Pad-to-Max-Length Batching (Pad 1,850-tok Average Samples to 16,384 + Unfused Logits OOM)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 传统 Pad-to-Max-Length 硬填充 (均长 1,850 词被硬填到 16,384 词：78.4% 算力全在算 <pad> 空气)
tiers.mechanism: Pads every batch to max_seq_len=16,384 (or batch max) and materializes full [B, S, 128256] FP32 logits in HBM

tiers.name: Tier 2: Naive Concatenated Packing without Document Mask (EOS-Only Concat -> Cross-Sample Attention Contamination)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 粗放首尾拼接打包无跨样本隔离 (仅靠 <eos> 拼接：样本 B 偷看样本 A 上下文 + RoPE 位置偏移污染)
tiers.mechanism: Concatenates multiple SFT samples into 16K blocks separated only by <eos>, using a single full-block causal triangle mask

tiers.name: Tier 3: Padding-Free First-Fit-Decreasing (FFD) Packing + flash_attn_varlen_func (cu_seqlens + Position Reset)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 零填充 FFD 装箱 + flash_attn_varlen_func (cu_seqlens 严格块对角掩码隔离 + 逐样本 RoPE 归零)
tiers.mechanism: Packs 1D flattened tokens with cu_seqlens array into flash_attn_varlen_func and resets position_ids=0 at each sample boundary

tiers.name: Tier 4: Padding-Free cu_seqlens Packing + Liger FusedLinearCrossEntropy (0GB Logits) + rsLoRA/DoRA (alpha/sqrt(r))
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 零填充 cu_seqlens 打包 + Liger 融合线性交叉熵 (消除 16.8GB 词表峰值) + rsLoRA/DoRA 秩稳定微调
tiers.mechanism: Combines cu_seqlens block-diagonal packing with chunked in-place FusedLinearCrossEntropy (never materializing [S, 128256] logits) & rsLoRA

rank_and_skew_perturbation.insight: At low rank r=16, standard alpha/r scaling and rsLoRA alpha/sqrt(r) both converge smoothly

rank_and_skew_perturbation.condition: LoRA Rank r=64 (Standard Enterprise Multi-Task SFT)
rank_and_skew_perturbation.insight: rsLoRA scaling by alpha/sqrt(r) + DoRA magnitude-direction decoupling unlocks +4.0pt higher accuracy

rank_and_skew_perturbation.condition: High-Rank LoRA r=256 (Heavy Reasoning / Code Knowledge Injection)
rank_and_skew_perturbation.insight: Standard LoRA (alpha/r) suffers gradient norm collapse at r=256 (74.5%); rsLoRA scales monotonically to 86.4%!
Unfused LM-Head materializes 33.6 GB FP32 logits (OOM!); Liger FusedLinearCrossEntropy caps peak at 0.52 GB
